description: Download the file associated with a Recycled Document Revision. Requires Recycle Bin view permission on the requested revision.

parameters.name: no_redirect
parameters.description: If this query parameter is set to true, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

200.description: If the `no_redirect=true` query parameter is provided, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

400.description:
document_revision_id is not a valid ULID.

Possible reason codes:
- INVALID_PROPERTY

403.description:
The caller is not permitted to view this revision in the Recycle Bin. This route serves the Recycle Bin only, so an active (non-recycled) revision id is also rejected here — use GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/document_management/document_revisions/{document_revision_id}/download instead.

Possible reason codes:
- ACCESS_DENIED

404.description:
No recycled document revision matched the id.

Possible reason codes:
- NOT_FOUND

410.description:
Document metadata is present but the file data could not be found

Possible reason codes:
- GONE
